title: Research Brief
summary: Personal observatory pipeline — Notion Thinking Vault as input, Obsidian as memory/graph, public MUJI homepage as the projection on this site.
problem: How can captured reading and thinking become a durable, public, graph-linked research memory?
architecture: Content Lake + Knowledge Objects + one-way Notion → vault/Thinking sync. Public HTML is the MUJI Observatory homepage in frontend/, copied onto carrylewis.com.
designPhilosophy: Notion is the input layer; Obsidian is the memory/graph layer; the website is the public projection.
implementation: Embedded MUJI homepage from CarryLewis/research_brief frontend/. Source tip pinned in research-brief-embed.ref (cursor/muji-homepage-prototype-5c8e @ 8bfa32e).
